॥ Om, by the absence of any statement to the contrary regarding liberation, Om ॥ 1/3/2 ॥

— “This is the bridge to immortality.” “One who knows Brahman attains the Supreme.” “Narayana, the Great to be known, the all-pervading Self, the ultimate refuge.” “The supreme destination of the liberated.” “One approaches that blissful Self.” And so on, by the absence of any statement to the contrary regarding the attainability of liberation for that very Self. “What more need be said? As long as one does not reach the white (light), the yogi is not liberated. This is the decisive conclusion of the scriptures.” Thus in the Iti Purana. ॥ 2 ॥
